blocks.title: Guarding against pharming
blocks.text: Pharming se bachne ke liye koi bhi tafseel dalne se pehle jaanchein ke website ka address durust aur mehfooz hai, https:// se shuru aur address bar mein taale ke saath.
Mo-assar online hifazat mukhtalif khatron ke liye kai tadabeer milati hai, spam filters, antivirus software aur cookies ka ehtiyat se intezam (Tip).

blocks.prompt: Taala nazar aa raha hai magar address aap ke bank ke asal domain ki bajaye 'my-bank-login.example.com' hai. Kya yeh mehfooz hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Taala sirf yeh batata hai ke rabta encrypted hai; khud domain bank ka asal address hona chahiye.

items: Pharming ke khilaf: theek address, https aur taala jaanchein.
